main_topics.reason: The user described blood and urgency returning after months of stability and said the symptoms were worsening day by day.
The user asked whether antibodies could explain the change and how the body might start reacting to Humira after months of use.
The user asked whether these tests could be checked at the upcoming appointment and included them in their preparation list.
The user asked what might happen if Humira was failing and whether other treatment options existed.
The user asked whether dietary changes could help and said urgency made them reluctant to eat.
The user said they were scared the symptoms marked a flare and later said they felt calmer after discussing the situation.
The user noted that the gastro appointment was weeks away and asked whether it was okay to wait until then.

output.summary: After months of stability on Humira, the user reported several days of recurring urgency and small amounts of blood that were becoming more frequent, and asked about antibodies, tests, and possible treatment changes. The assistant helped the user prepare questions and discuss symptom tracking and diet; when asked whether to wait several weeks for the appointment despite worsening symptoms, it suggested the appointment was the natural place to address things unless there was a dramatic change. The user said they felt calmer, but the worsening bloody symptoms were not clearly addressed as a reason to seek advice sooner.
